market_story: nuclear: MISO's 13 reactors do not refuel or trip in unison — the NRC daily record shows the 2025 scarce weeks with the South fleet (Waterford 3, Grand Gulf, River Bend, ANO 1+2) near full power (0.954 capacity-weighted) while the Midwest carried the real concentrated outages (Callaway 68.9%, Clinton 77.2%, Monticello 86.8%). The uniform fleet-month smear under-supplied the South and over-supplied the Midwest in exactly the hours that decide the regional direction transfer; the overlay posts each reactor's measured daily availability (monthly energy still anchored to EIA-923), so the LP's baseload floor sits where the real fleet actually was. Wind/solar/gas classes are untouched; annual nuclear energy moves <0.2 TWh/yr.
